offer.text: Light the far end of the road, not this end. Twelve lanterns around the other village and a drover can walk it after dark without praying.

accept.text: The far end. I will know if you cheat.

decline.text: Then the road closes at dusk, as it always has.

in_progress.text: The other village. Not this square.

ready.text: You can see it from the ridge. Twelve lights.

complete.text: The road is open at night now. That is a real thing you did.
